panels.title: ⚡ Autenticação Lambda Auth ➔ register-service & Governança RBAC

targets.expr: sum(aws_lambda_invocations_sum{function_name=~"repairshop-lambda-auth.*"}) or sum(max by (instance, uri, method, status) (http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="repairshop-actuator", instance=~"register-service(:.*)?", uri=~"/auth/.*"} or http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="repairshop-actuator", application="register-service", uri=~"/auth/.*"})) or vector(0)
sum(max by (instance, uri, method, status) (http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="repairshop-actuator", status=~"401|403"})) or vector(0)

(avg(aws_lambda_duration_milliseconds_sum / (aws_lambda_duration_milliseconds_count or vector(1))) or (sum(max by (instance, uri, method, status) (http_server_requests_seconds_sum{job="repairshop-actuator", instance=~"register-service(:.*)?", uri="/auth/login"})) / sum(max by (instance, uri, method, status) (http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="repairshop-actuator", instance=~"register-service(:.*)?", uri="/auth/login"})) * 1000)) or vector(0)

100 - ((sum(max by (instance, uri, method, status) (http_server_requests_seconds_count{instance=~"register-service(:.*)?", uri=~"/auth/.*", status=~"5.."})) / (sum(max by (instance, uri, method, status) (http_server_requests_seconds_count{instance=~"register-service(:.*)?", uri=~"/auth/.*"})) or vector(1))) * 100) or vector(100)

(avg(aws_lambda_duration_milliseconds_sum / (aws_lambda_duration_milliseconds_count or vector(1))) or (sum(max by (instance, uri, method, status) (http_server_requests_seconds_sum{job="repairshop-actuator", instance=~"register-service(:.*)?", uri="/auth/login"})) / sum(max by (instance, uri, method, status) (http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="repairshop-actuator", instance=~"register-service(:.*)?", uri="/auth/login"})) * 1000)) or vector(0)

panels.title: 📈 Taxa de Requisições Auth/RBAC & Latência Percentil

targets.expr: sum by (uri, status) (max by (instance, uri, method, status) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{instance=~"register-service(:.*)?", uri=~"/auth/.*"}[1m])))
sum by (instance, status) (max by (instance, uri, method, status) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{status=~"401|403"}[1m])))

panels.title: Auth Downstream Latency (Avg & p95 em ms)

targets.expr: (sum(max by (instance, uri, method, status) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{instance=~"register-service(:.*)?", uri=~"/auth/.*"}[1m]))) / sum(max by (instance, uri, method, status) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{instance=~"register-service(:.*)?", uri=~"/auth/.*"}[1m])))) * 1000
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (max by (le, instance, uri, method, status) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{instance=~"register-service(:.*)?", uri=~"/auth/.*"}[1m])))) * 1000

value.title: 🔍 Abrir Waterfall do Trace no Jaeger

targets.expr: {job="register-service"} | json | line_format "[{{.severity}}] {{ if .traceid }}[trace={{.traceid}}] {{ end }}{{ if .instrumentation_scope_name }}({{.instrumentation_scope_name}}) {{ end }}{{.body}}"
